column3: [nervous] Dealer quoted her thirty-eight hundred. Says it's the transmission.
[on the phone, amused] She says it goes wub-wub-wub over forty.
[nervous] Could be anything. Bearing, axle, CV joint...
[dry] She does a very good wub.
[panicked] Customer's neighbor says head gasket. Twenty-two hundred.
Just a minute. When it's cold.
[excited] Other shop quoted twelve hundred. Rotors, calipers, everything.
[deadpan] That squeal's the wear tab. Pads only.
[proud] Customer looked it up. That rattle's a nine-hundred-dollar repair.
[proud] My app says this check engine light is a five-thousand-dollar repair.
[defeated] The app was ninety-nine a month.
[nervous] Dealer says it's knocking. Wants a new engine. Seven grand.
[deadpan] That's not a knock. That's a tick.
